column1: # Derived from the Lancaster Sensorimotor Norms (Lynott, Connell, Brysbaert, Brand & Carney, 2020),
# licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: single words only,
# lowercased; only words whose strongest perceptual modality rates at least 3.5 and leads the
# next modality by at least 0.5, not counting interoception as the next modality of a haptic
# word; columns reduced to the dominant modality (v visual, a auditory, h haptic, o olfactory,
# g gustatory, i interoceptive), its mean strength and that lead, both in tenths of a rating point
